readout_other: PGCS; CRS-R; ADL; FOIS; Rancho Los Amigos; resting-state fMRI functional connectivity (CONN, PCC seed)
direction_notes: Single paediatric patient improved clinically (PGCS 8 to 15, CRS-R 8 to 20 by week 4); fMRI showed strengthened default-mode and task-positive connectivity with some weakened couplings. No control condition.
safety_notes: No adverse events were reported throughout the intervention.

timing.protocol_description: 20-minute sessions three times per week for 12 sessions; TBD 0.3 ms, PRP 5 ms, PRF 200 Hz, sonication duration 1 s, stimulation period 6 s, DC 6%.

source_quotes.n_subjects: A single pediatric patient with pDOC received 12 sessions of neuroimaging-guided LIFU targeting the left thalamus.
source_quotes.n_sessions_per_subject: The treatment regimen consisted of 20- minute sessions administered three times per week, for a total of 12 intervention sessions.
